en.headline: FEHD prosecutes Kwai Chung café over hygiene after live mouse in takeaway
en.dek: The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department inspected a factory canteen in Kwai Chung after a customer reported a live young mouse in a takeaway order and found hygiene shortcomings, leading to an immediate prosecution.
body: The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department said it received a complaint on Monday that a customer had found a suspected live young mouse in a takeaway meal bought from a food premises in Kwai Chung. Officers immediately collected the food item, inspected the premises and opened an investigation.

During the inspection, the department found that some areas of the premises, which holds a valid factory canteen licence, had unsatisfactory hygiene conditions. It prosecuted the operator under the Food Business Regulation and required immediate improvements. The department said it was examining the food preparation, packaging, storage and delivery stages and that it was not appropriate at this stage to determine solely from online footage or the presence of the animal when or how it entered the food.

The department noted that the premises had no similar complaints recorded in the past 12 months. It would continue to monitor hygiene and pest-control measures at the site. The operator said the shop would close for one day for thorough cleaning and disinfection and that it had never previously encountered such an incident in more than a year of operation.

zh.headline: 葵涌冰室外賣現活鼠 食環署指衞生欠佳已檢控
zh.dek: 食環署接獲投訴指市民在葵涌一間食肆購買的外賣發現懷疑幼鼠後即時巡查，發現部分地方衞生欠佳，已向經營者提出檢控並要求即時改善。
body: 食物環境衞生署表示，今日接獲投訴，指有市民在葵涌一間食肆購買的外賣食物中發現懷疑幼鼠。署方隨即派員跟進，檢取涉事食物，並到處所巡查及展開調查。
巡查期間，食環署發現涉事持有有效工廠食堂牌照的食肆部分地方衞生情況欠佳，遂根據《食物業規例》向經營者提出檢控，並要求負責人即時作出改善。署方正從食物製作、包裝、存放及交付等環節調查，現階段不宜單憑網上片段或食物中發現懷疑幼鼠的情況，判斷幼鼠何時及如何進入食物。
食環署指，涉事處所過去12個月未有接獲類似投訴，署方會繼續監察處所的衞生及防治蟲鼠措施。食肆負責人表示，店舖將暫停營業一日進行徹底清潔消毒，並指開業年多從未發生同類事件。
